newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may upgrade Providian debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may upgrade Providian debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it placed Providian Corp's approximately $780 million in senior debt and $100 million in monthly income preferred stock on rating watch for a possible upgrade.
It also reaffirmed the senior debt rating of Aegon USA, a unit of Aegon NV.
The action follows Aegon USA's announcement that it signed a definitive agreement to acquire the life insurance subsidiaries of Providian in a stock-for-stock exchange.
Duff & Phelps currently rates Providian's senior debt Double A Minus and its preferred stock Single A Plus. It rates Aegon USA's senior debt Double A.

Duff & Phelps said its reaffirmation of all claims-paying ability ratings of Aegon USA and Providian subsidiaries at Double A Plus recognizes the agency's view that the acquisition of Providian's life insurance subsidiaries is a good strategic fit for the Aegon USA Life Insurance Group.
